Get ready to elevate your mind, body, and spirit at the YogaRama Kundalini Faire – a transformative experience awaits!

About this Event

✨Join us for a 2-Hour Special Immersive Event at the beautiful Meditation Center Nalanda West ✨

 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events4/banners/6996d820-a113-11f1-8382-27c8b4f8dbac-rimg-w1108-h740-dcd8c8c8-gmir.jpg 

YOGA & MEDITATION
Join us for a powerful evening of kundalini yoga, meditation, chanting, and pranayam (breathwork) designed to elevate your energy and deepen your connection.

LAYOUT & SOUND BATH
Experience a long restorative layout with a guided meditation by Soulistic Magic, enhanced by multiple facilitators playing gongs & singing bowls all around you.

HIGHLIGHT
🌙 Soulistic Magic @soulisticmagic (Leslie & Joelle) will guide you through a transcendent meditation woven with singing bowls for a truly etheric journey.

🍈🍉🍊🍋 Nourishing Treats from Yogarama + Community Time Included 🍋🫐🍌🥭

You can also visit us to sign up at www.yogarama.com

LOCATION
Nalanda West in Fremont
3902 Woodland Park Ave N, Seattle, WA 98103
Plenty of parking at this beautiful facility

WHAT TO BRING
Yoga Mat, Pillow, blanket and anything for your comfort. Bottle of Water.

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Seattle.
